stem: Pod A is at depth −8 km and pod B at −3 km on the trench wall axis. Point C divides AB internally in the ratio 1:4. Mark C on the number line.
solution: Internal division with m=1, n=4: $x=\frac{n a+m b}{m+n}$.

hints.text: Cross-multiply: weight each end by the other part of the ratio, then divide by the sum.
Only one point C is asked for.
Both coordinates are negative; keep their signs.
